description: This source file defines the 'AttributeModified' event class, which models an event emitted after an attribute of a 'Thing' has been modified. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization methods, and accessors for the attribute key and value.

classes.name: AttributeModified
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that an attribute of a Thing was modified, including attribute key and value, and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: AttributeModified.of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of AttributeModified with specified parameters.

methods.name: AttributeModified.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributeModified instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the pointer/key of the modified attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the modified attribute.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with the specified DittoHeaders.
